desc: Read input: H, W, X, P, Q, and the H×W grid of strengths.
Initialize: current strength = S[P-1][Q-1], visited set with (P-1,Q-1), and a min-heap containing the (up to 4) neighbors of the start cell.
Loop: pop the minimum-strength boundary slime from the heap (skipping already-visited entries); if heap empties, stop.
Check absorb condition: slime_strength * X < current_strength (strict). If false, terminate the loop (no absorbable slime remains).
If true: add slime strength to current, mark cell visited, push all unvisited in-bounds neighbors onto the heap.
Implement solve() in Python: read H, W, X, P, Q and the grid from stdin; use a min-heap of (strength, row, col) for the boundary, a visited 2D array, absorb while min*X < cur, then print cur.
